source_snapshot.items_direct_xlsx: Out Of Band: UMC Uncorrectable Address Or Command Parity Single Shot
source_snapshot.procedure_direct_xlsx: 1. SSH into BMC console and execute the following command to check for current CPER index: # curl -X GET 'http://192.168.31.1/redfish/v1/Systems/UBB/LogServices/Dump/Entries' | grep -o '""Id"": ""[^""]*' | grep -o '[0-9]*$' | sort -n | tail -1 2. Execute the following command to inject uncorrectable address/command parity error with single shot method to device_id = 0, block_id = 0 (UMC): $ sudo amdgpuras -d 0 -b 0 -s 4 -t 4 -m 1 3. SSH into BMC Console and repeat Step 1 to check for current CPER index again after injection: # curl -X GET 'http://192.168.31.1/redfish/v1/Systems/UBB/LogServices/Dump/Entries' | grep -o '""Id"": ""[^""]*' | grep -o '[0-9]*$' | sort -n | tail -1 4. SSH into BMC console and run the following command to download that generated CPER file into BMC from SMC: # curl -X GET 'http://192.168.31.1/redfish/v1/Systems/UBB/LogServices/Dump/Entries/<cper_index>/attachment' --output /tmp/<cper_index>.cper 5. Use scp command to copy downloaded CPER file from BMC to host. There are two ways to do the transfer, either scp at host or scp at BMC console. scp at host requires BMC details to fill in below (bmc_ip, bmc_user) and enter BMC login password for the prompt. $ scp -o ""<bmc_user>@<bmc_ip>:/tmp/<cper_index>.cper"" scp at BMC console, requires Host details to fill in below (host_ip, host_user) and enter Host login password for the prompt. $ scp –o /tmp/<cper_index>.cper ""<host_user>@<host_ip>:/home/<host_user>/"" 6. Execute the following command to decode the downloaded CPER file: $ cdump_analyzer -i <cper_index>.cper -o <cper_index>.cper.json
source_snapshot.criteria_direct_xlsx: • PASS = - AMDGPURAS tool UMC error injection command returns successfully. - Redfish command for CPER index retrieval shows the CPER index is increased by 1 and new CPER file is generated upon the error injected. - The decoded result from the decoded CPER log matches the injected error type and location. • Error location lists the OAM on which the error occurred. • Bank matches the type of error injected: UMC. • Errorcode ext is 4 and Errocode ext Type is AddressCommandParityErr. • Error severity matches the type of error injected: Uncorrected system fatal error.
